### struct `Entry`

```rust

    pub error: Option<String>,
}
```

### enum `Message`

What the writing thread accepts: rows, and a request to say when it has caught up.

```rust
#[derive(Debug)]
enum Message {
    Row(Box<Entry>),
    Flush(Sender<()>),
}
```

### struct `Journal`

A handle onto the writing thread. Cloning it is how each connection gets one.

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Journal {
    tx: Sender<Message>,
}
```
